MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The wired earbuds fit my use of wired headphones and give me a compact option to carry in my laptop bag.",
    "The microSD card connects naturally to my Raspberry Pi projects as extra storage, provided it is compatible; my Garmin card purchase does not establish that it would work there.",
    "The HDMI cable fits the equipment I connect, although I would only choose it when I actually need more length than my existing cable provides."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and smart display add voice control or a dedicated screen, neither of which addresses the computer and workspace needs reflected in my recent choices.",
    "The streaming sticks do not follow from my Raspberry Pi entertainment project: working on that setup does not mean I want another streaming device or need a 4K upgrade.",
    "The Fire tablet offers another portable screen, but owning a Kindle and using a laptop gives me no clear reason to add one now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into interest in smart speakers, tablets, and streaming devices, even though their purposes differ from the accessories I have been choosing.",
    "My Kindle purchase seems to have been treated as interest in other Amazon devices, when the useful connection for me is what a device helps me do."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter, Ethernet cables, headphone mount, and computer duster point toward connecting, organizing, and maintaining my existing equipment.",
    "An accessory can fit my setup without being needed immediately: another HDMI cable depends on a specific length requirement, while additional storage has a clearer project use.",
    "Compatibility matters for storage and connections; a card useful for a Raspberry Pi should not automatically be assumed suitable for my Garmin."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized some useful accessory needs, but read my practical equipment projects as broader interest in smart-home and entertainment devices."
}
